eas_text: A civil authority has issued AN ADMINISTRATIVE MESSAGE for the following counties or areas: Arizona; at 6:14 PM on AUG 13, 2023 Effective until 4:14 AM AUG 14, 2023. Message from WSLF/CAP.
extra_text: A Silver Alert has been issued for Phoenix Police Department.  This is the Arizona Department of Public Safety.  Phoenix Police Department is looking for Mary Ann Le Beau. last seen on foot wearing dark colored t-shirt and black pants near Cave Creek Road and Grovers Avenue, in Phoenix, Arizona. If you have contact with the Silver Alert, Please call 9 1 1.  Monitor TV and Radio for updates.
